currentFocus.description: The focus export's `currentFocus`. When it names this overlay's focus mode, the overlay renders VISIBLE in server markup, so a client without JavaScript sees it too (atlas decision 0160). Omitted → hidden until the client runtime (updateFocusOverlay) shows it.

anyOf.description: ISO time of the render. Unused since atlas decision 0164 D5: the server renders the `--:--:--` clock placeholder and updateFocusOverlay writes the time. Kept so existing callers still type-check; drop it at the next major.
